From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Meeting notes & actions — OrbitalHealth CAIQ data flow / log capture session (recap)

Hi all — thanks again for today's session. Notes and agreed actions below. Attendees: Elena, Raj, Laura (OrbitalHealth); Tessa, Olga, Marissa (Redwood).

Summary:
- Walked through end-to-end data flow diagram: ingest -> transient processing -> model inference -> results storage -> optional export. We annotated points where PII can appear (ingest) and where tokens are cached (inference layer).
- Logging: agreed Redwood will provide three sanitized log types: ingest, worker, auth. OrbitalHealth confirmed the 72h window and Laura asked for a README that lists fields and redaction applied.
- Evidence handoff: agreed to use a shared evidence register (sheet) and SFTP transfer for sensitive artifacts. OrbitalHealth will confirm SFTP endpoint or provide a secure upload link.

Action items (owners & target dates):
1) Olga (Redwood) — produce sanitized log samples + README; upload to Drive and SFTP by 11/04 EOD.
2) Marissa (Redwood) — populate CAIQ mapping template with initial answers for sections A1–A3; share by 11/05 COB.
3) Laura Jenkins (OrbitalHealth) — confirm SFTP endpoint or provide secure upload link and list any additional exclusions; due 11/04 COB.
4) Tessa (Redwood) — compile action register and send an evidence intake checklist; due 11/04 AM.

Attachments included: orbital_caiq_action_register.xlsx, caiq_mapping_notes.pdf (initial mapping bullets).

Next steps:
- After OrbitalHealth confirms upload method, Redwood will push sanitized logs to the agreed location and notify Laura.
- We'll schedule a follow-up for detailed CAIQ row review if needed (30–45m).

If I've missed anything or owners prefer different dates, reply-all and we'll update the register.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

--Attachments: orbital_caiq_action_register.xlsx, caiq_mapping_notes.pdf
